description: After a clean review: trims the blank lead-in of the approved take, applies any post-process zooms, and encodes video/<slug>.mp4 (H.264) and a copy under 10 MB, then writes video-package.md with sizes, what is real and what was scripted, how to re-record, and the upload note.

params.label: File name
params.description: Base name of the MP4 files; default: the take name without -cycleN.

params.label: Small copy limit (MB)
params.description: The small copy stays under this size.
